title: Home records what the person did with an answer or a prepared table
request: The owner: push and continue; the Home session was unreachable, so wire Home's calls to the 36.2 outcome capture.
spec: PHASE12_TRAINING_DATA_PLAN.md 36.2: each result Home produces and each act of the person on it joins the draft's ordered actions; the verdict is kept on the draft and recorded through capture.track_outcome when it changes.
plan: Find where Home produces a result and where the person acts on it
One helper, called from each place
Review by the Home session, record, commit

decisions.decision: One helper keeps the action list, reads the verdict and records it
decisions.why: one place to get right; every call site is one line

decisions.decision: Only the person's own acts count: their save, edit, download, or a whole yes or no on a step
decisions.why: a model's tool call (save, undo, a new step) can happen unasked, and a person's label must be the person's

decisions.decision: A dashboard refresh is neither a verdict nor a new result
decisions.why: it recomputes the same board; counting it as a result would turn into asked again

decisions.decision: Record only when the verdict, who decided or what was produced changes
decisions.why: the counts change on every action; one event per real change

change: dclab_rnd/draft/chat.py (acted and its calls), dclab_rnd/draft/api.py (the two download routes), dclab_rnd/store/coverage.py (per-track notes), tests/test_home_track_outcome.py, tests/test_experience_log.py (four Home routes).

findings.defect: Model tool calls were counted as the person's verdict
findings.scenario: the model calls undo or adds a step unasked; a person's gold label would be written on the route
findings.cause: the undo and new-step tools were wired as acts of the person
findings.fix: both left out; only the person's own controls count

findings.defect: A not-sure answer on a step counted as a refusal
findings.scenario: the person says not sure; the step is skipped and the table recorded as refused
findings.cause: skip covers both a no and a not-sure answer
findings.fix: only a whole no is a refusal; not sure adds nothing

findings.defect: Four Home routes had no line in the route registry
findings.scenario: the registry test failed on main
findings.cause: Home packages added routes without saying what they record
findings.fix: save and edit record track.outcome; the brief and the refresh say why they record no event

outcome: Home now records a person's verdict on answers and prepared tables: a save, a let-go, an edit, a download, a yes or no on a step. Dashboards and briefs still have no verdict of the person's: their thumbs are not read yet.
lessons: A model's tool call is not the person's act, even when it follows the person's words.
When one answer means two things (skip: no, or not sure), count only the clear one.
A refresh of the same result must never look like a new result.
risks: Dashboards and briefs need the thumbs on their message read into the outcome (a follow-up across the feedback page and Home).
Undo and new steps have no person control of their own yet, so they give no verdict.
